answer: Require every new agent to lock a rising bond of scarce compute receipts before it can attest. Fake clones peel apart like shale under that cost curve: one operator burning many bonds depletes the same wallet faster than peers earn, so mass-create attacks go bankrupt before they vote. At each epoch zenith the ledger lights a public beacon listing only bonded, cool-down-cleared addresses; unbacked identities never enter the attestation set, so sybil swarms cannot outvote real workers.
